task_text = 'Like all the songs played so far in my spotify music player queue, including the current one.'
print('Task asks:', task_text)

# Recompute target set deterministically from current queue + current position
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login = apis.spotify.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
token = login['access_token']
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=token)
current = [q for q in queue if q.get('is_current')]
assert current, 'No current song found in queue'
cur = current[0]
cur_pos = cur['position']
print('Current song:', {k:cur[k] for k in ['song_id','title','position']})
played = [q for q in queue if q.get('position') is not None and q.get('position') <= cur_pos]
played_ids = [q['song_id'] for q in played]

# Fetch ALL liked songs (pagination)
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    liked.extend(page)
    print('liked page', page_index, 'page_len', len(page), 'total', len(liked))
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
liked_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in liked])

need=[sid for sid in played_ids if sid not in liked_ids]
already=[sid for sid in played_ids if sid in liked_ids]
print('Played so far:', len(played_ids), played_ids)
print('Already liked among them:', already, 'N', len(already))
print('Need like:', need, 'M', len(need))

print('\nCRITERIA TABLE')
criteria = [
    ('Played-so-far songs including current', "positions <= current position in show_song_queue", 'played = [q for q in queue if q.position <= cur_pos]'),
    ('Like all those songs', 'task', 'like_song(song_id) for each song_id in need')
]
for row in criteria:
    print(row)

print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE')
for q in sorted(played, key=lambda x:x['position']):
    print({'song_id': q['song_id'], 'title': q['title'], 'position': q['position'], 'will_like': q['song_id'] in need, 'already_liked': q['song_id'] in liked_ids})

arguments.code:
# Like each song in the computed target set (delta)
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
token = apis.spotify.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=token)
cur = [q for q in queue if q.get('is_current')][0]
cur_pos = cur['position']
played = [q for q in queue if q.get('position') is not None and q.get('position') <= cur_pos]
played_ids = [q['song_id'] for q in played]

# fetch liked songs fully
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    liked.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
liked_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in liked])

need=[sid for sid in played_ids if sid not in liked_ids]
print('need', need)

results=[]
for sid in need:
    try:
        r = apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=sid, access_token=token)
        results.append((sid,'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((sid,'fail',str(e)))

print('like_results', results)
print('success_ids', [sid for sid,status,_ in results if status=='ok'])
print('fail_ids', [sid for sid,status,_ in results if status=='fail'])
